blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Top-ranked Filipino contender Carl Jammes “Wonder Boy” Martin entered his World Boxing Council (WBC) Silver featherweight title fight as a heavy underdog but will return home to Mountain Province as a champion. Martin pulled off a massive upset, dethroning erstwhile champion and former world title challenger David Picasso of Mexico via […]...
